title: chortle
summary: A laughing word hidden in an old story. Hunt through places and time.
question: Can you follow this laughing word back to an animal sound?
completion: You followed three links: today’s chortle → Carroll’s poem → its probable chuckle ingredient → Middle English chukken, a clucking sound. Collins calls chuckle + snort a probable blend, not a certainty. Oxford marks an author association, not a proven birthplace.
partner: A book can be a clue. Look closely at its words and its date!
